    records = []
    for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        item = json.loads(line)
        if item.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and item.get('package_id') == package_id and \
                item.get('target', {}).get('name') == target_name and item.get('executable'):
            require(item['target']['kind'] == [target_kind] and

                    'Cargo executable has a wrong target/source/profile')
            records.append(Path(item['executable']))
    require(len(records) == 1, 'expected actual executable missing or duplicate')

    require(path.is_relative_to(OUT/'cargo-target') and '..' not in path.parts,

def actual_executable(raw, package_id, target_name, target_kind, source_path, test):
    records = []
    for line in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        item = json.loads(line)
        if item.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact' and item.get('package_id') == package_id and \
                item.get('target', {}).get('name') == target_name and item.get('executable'):
            require(item['target']['kind'] == [target_kind] and
                    item['target']['src_path'] == str(source_path) and
                    item['profile']['test'] is test,
                    'Cargo executable has a wrong target/source/profile')
            profile = item['profile']
            require('debuginfo' in profile and profile.get('opt_level') == '3' and
                    profile.get('debug_assertions') is False and
                    profile.get('overflow_checks') is False and
                    (profile.get('debuginfo') is None or
                     type(profile['debuginfo']) is int and profile['debuginfo'] == 0),
                    'actual selected executable is not the original workspace default release profile')
            records.append((Path(item['executable']), dict(profile)))
    require(len(records) == 1, 'expected actual executable missing or duplicate')
    path, profile = records[0]
    require(path.is_relative_to(OUT/'cargo-target/release') and '..' not in path.parts,
            'actual executable escaped the fresh owned release Cargo target')
    real_directory(path.parent)
    data, pin = held(path, 128*1024*1024)
    require(len(data) >= 64 and data[:6] == b'\x7fELF\x02\x01' and
            int.from_bytes(data[16:18], 'little') in (2, 3) and
            int.from_bytes(data[18:20], 'little') == 62 and pin['identity'][2] & 0o111,
            'actual release executable is not an executable regular x86_64 ELF64')
    return path, pin, profile

def qualify_debug_parent(report):
    raw, pin = pinned_packet('status-debug02-result.json',
        '9fa8108aab968a2a7428906fea074c44010e7a12bac545d78361c04c27e9cae6')
    parent = json.loads(raw)
    require(pin['bytes'] == 144339 and parent['state'] == 'PASS' and
            parent['compiled_status_protocol_qualified'] is True and
            parent['source_delta']['actual_source_file_count'] == 502 and
            parent['copied_manifest'] == {
                'path':'/home/alex/work/p4-st02-20261106/attempt01/copied-status-source-manifest.json',
                'bytes':99958, 'sha256':MANIFEST_CANDIDATE} and
            parent['expected_dispatch_and_preserved_gate_tests'] == LIB_TESTS and
            parent['expected_cli_tests'] == CLI_TESTS and
            parent['focused_tests_passed'] == 15 and
            [row['exact_name'] for row in parent['focused_result_gates']] == LIB_TESTS+CLI_TESTS and
            all(row['summary_and_independent_result_agree'] is True and row['outer_results'] == 1
                for row in parent['focused_result_gates']) and
            parent['actual_registered_test_counts'] == {'supervisor_library':112, 'cli_lifecycle':7} and
            len(parent['commands']) == 38 and
            all(row['returncode'] == 0 and row['child_reaped'] is True and
                row['owned_tree_cleanup_complete'] is True and row['pidfd_closed'] is True and
                row['output_fds_closed'] is True and row['stdout_complete'] is True and
                row['stderr_complete'] is True and row['timed_out'] is False and
                row['first_error'] is None and row['secondary_errors'] == []
                for row in parent['commands']),
            'actual debug02 complete source and selected test authority differs')
    require([row['name'] for row in parent['host_child_lifecycle_controls']] ==
                ['timeout-descendant', 'escaped-descendant', 'pidfd-failure'] and
            all(row['passed'] is True for row in parent['host_child_lifecycle_controls']) and
            parent['owned_child_reaper']['final_children_empty'] is True and
            parent['owned_child_reaper']['restored'] is True and
            all(parent[label+'_baseline_established'] is True and
                parent[label+'_unchanged_after'] is True
                for label in ('original_source', 'copied_source', 'control_source')) and
            parent['dependency_changes'] == parent['tool_changes'] == parent['artifact_changes'] == [] and
            parent['cargo_configs_unchanged_after'] is True and
            parent['observed_signals'] == parent['secondary_errors'] == [] and
            parent['owned_resource_gate']['pass'] is True and
            parent['owned_resource_fd_closed'] is True and
            parent['Main_actions'] == 0 and parent['install_actions'] == 0 and
            parent['Android_or_Soong_executed'] is False and parent['namespace_entry'] is False and
            parent['deployed'] is False and parent['production_ready'] is False,
            'actual debug02 cleanup, immutable inputs or no-deployment boundary differs')
    names = {name for _, name, _ in HOST_BINARIES} | {'supervisor-libtest', 'cli-lifecycle-test'}
    require(set(parent['actual_elfs']) == names, 'actual debug02 six-artifact set differs')
    for name, row in parent['actual_elfs'].items():
        path = PurePosixPath(row['path'])
        require(path.is_relative_to('/home/alex/work/p4-st02-20261106/attempt01/cargo-target/debug') and
                '..' not in path.parts and type(row['bytes']) is int and row['bytes'] > 0 and
                re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', row['sha256']) is not None and
                (name in ('supervisor-libtest', 'cli-lifecycle-test') or path.name == name),
                'actual debug02 original artifact path or content pin differs')
    report['actual_debug02_authority'] = pin
    report['debug_artifacts_are_release_artifacts'] = False
    report['old_debug_ELFs_read_or_reused'] = False

def execute():

dependency_rows, tool_rows, config_rows, config_paths, artifact_pins = {}, [], [], [], {}
    artifact_profiles = {}

report['copied_manifest'] = write_new(OUT/'copied-status-source-manifest.json', new_raw)
        qualify_debug_parent(report)
        workspace_raw, workspace_pin = held(COPIED/'Cargo.toml', 65536)
        require(workspace_pin['bytes'] == 1996 and
                workspace_pin['sha256'] == 'e33185d2fc5a65e0a4ed6df552e4f8f8f40c793ec07f7289ed27e3c0d5fa4e60' and
                'profile' not in tomllib.loads(workspace_raw.decode('utf-8')),
                'original workspace Cargo release-profile authority differs')
        report['release_profile_source'] = {
            'workspace_manifest':workspace_pin, 'workspace_profile_override':False,
            'cargo_switch':'--release', 'selected_executable_opt_level':'3',
            'selected_executable_debug_assertions':False, 'selected_executable_overflow_checks':False,
            'selected_executable_debuginfo':0, 'dependency_build_profile_not_assumed':True,
            'new_LTO_strip_or_panic_override':False}

report['compiled_status_protocol_qualified'] = report['state'] == 'PASS'
        report['release_artifacts_qualified'] = (report['state'] == 'PASS' and
            set(artifact_profiles) == {name for _, name, _ in HOST_BINARIES} |
                {'supervisor-libtest', 'cli-lifecycle-test'})
